notes.title: encrypt. v1.1.0 | HOTFIX 1
notes.content:
Just some fixes The 'Enter' key now also resets the time if no checkpoint has been reached yet.
This makes speedruns much more convenient.
 Fixed a regex sequence when you want to place a text tile.
You could not enter any text.
 The "SaveStage" button was fixed.
 Jump animations were fixed.
The animations sometimes did not trigger.

notes.title: "encrypt." is coming soon! Pretty soon In fact...
notes.content:
Here are some of the many improvements in v1.1.0Interface New and improved UI
 Completely redesigned the New Stage Creator
 Added custom themes
 Added prompts when leaving the Stage Creator or deleting a Local Stage
 Changed the Custom Stages tab to use the Workshop
 Added the Stage Info Hub

New Tiles New Flag design
 Gravity Switch
 Weighted Cube
 Portal
 Text
 Spinning Saber
 Falling Spike
 Transparent Build Assists
 Filled Build Assists
 Upward-firing boosters
 Downward-firing boosters

If you want to read up on the properties and features of the tiles now so that you can get started right away when the game is released, you can do so here:
https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2105446254

The Biggest Gameplay Improvements The boosters have been improved immensely
They actually boost realistically you now.
 Almost every tile can be rotated
 Added a "Selected Range" Indicator above the selected Region in the Stage Creator
 You can now select the underlying tile by pressing middle click
 Change Toolbox tabs with the keys 1-4 or the keys 'Q' and 'E
 Removed the old and buggy "Backup Stage" feature
 You can speed up the camera speed in the Stage Creator with 'L Shift' and slow it down with 'L Alt'
 Stages can now be saved directly in the Stage Creator without having to play through them
 Trails were added to provide a better feeling of speed
 Camera now behaves more organic with the player
 Added sound effects and particle effects to make the game feel more rounded
 Camera effects (post processing, shaking, ...) were improved and now offer an even better experience
